question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. 

Dumb
solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is Vocal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dumb** means **not able to speak or Stupid (गूँगा, मूक) / (मूर्ख)**

 -Example: I played **dumb** but I don't think he's satisfied with all my answers.

 
• Marked option Vocal means **expressing your ideas or opinions loudly or freely. (कंठस्‍वर से संबंधित, स्‍वरीय​)**

 -Example: The woman was very **vocal **about racial issues and wouldn't backdown when questioned by the media.

 
• So it is clear that Dumb and **Vocal** are opposite in meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 **•** **Silent** means refusing to speak about something.

 

 ** • **__**Mute**__ means not speaking; not able to speak.

 ** • **__**Quiet**__ means with very little or no noise.
